paragraphs: Those who debate before the sages: Eduyot 1:10. Shimon ben Azzai, Shimon ben Zoma, Chanan the Egyptian, and Chananya ben Chakhinai. Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: also Shimon the Timnite. End of Sanhedrin chapter 1, 17b. In the Jerusalem Talmud, end of Maaser Sheni chapter 2: “These are those who debate: ben Azzai and ben Zoma. These are the students: Chananya ben Chakhinai and Rabbi Elazar ben Matya.” Yuchasin writes Chananya of Ono. In Maaser Sheni chapter 2 and other places: ben Azzai, ben Zoma, ben Nannas, and Chananya of Ono (see his entry).
